notes: One viewing, muted, from ordered frame strips of the exact preview film. Input: a tower camera sweeping dry plains. Action: its beam finds a small plume on open ground and a flag box locks on it, then an ALERT card travels down the tower to a crew phone. Result: an estimated window of up to ten minutes on the watch, the plume still burning, a dashed line from the alert to a responder badge that stops short, a calendar with no red mark, a blank record and a plan waiting on state approval. Every narrated action has a matching picture at its clause. Plumes, beams and lines are clear of both plate pumpjacks. The truck and alert stay above the caption band and no subject reaches the right button column. Per-frame motion, the opening pan speed and leg-tag drift need normal-speed playback. Treatment B was rejected for blocking defect B-D3, see openings/selection.json. Report transcribed by the director from the critic hand-back, digests computed by the director.

story_review.one_viewing_summary: Observed in the muted phone strips. A tower camera sweeps the plains. 16 of 56 cameras are up. At the tower's foot its beam finds smoke on open ground and flags it. An alert card runs down the tower to a crew phone. A watch marks an estimated window of up to ten minutes. The plume keeps burning and the cameras don't prevent fires. A dashed line from the truck's alert stops short of a responder badge. The utility's wildfire lead reports no major fire since launch over a calendar with no red mark. The response record stays blank. The plan waits on state approval.
story_review.opening_to_ending: Opens on the camera watching all the way around and ends on the alert landed with the crew, the line to responders open and the plan awaiting approval.
story_review.weakest_transition: s5-shot-2 to s6-shot-1: from the cut-in on the truck and station to a medium of the shelter wall.

subject_recognition.observed: A tall galvanised lattice tower with a white camera head sweeps a pale beam over red plains with a windmill fully in frame at left and a pumpjack in the distance. A close on the head then shows it turning to face the viewer as a West Texas tag settles on the rail.

contact_and_consequence.observed: The ALERT card lifts out of the camera head, travels down the tower, then drops toward the phone held in a leather glove and becomes the ALERT bubble on its screen at about 16.5 s. The bubble stays visible.

dominant_action.observed: The beam crosses the land onto a small plume on open ground left of the pumpjack and the orange flag box closes and locks on it from 12.5 to 13.5 s. The card then performs the send, down the tower to the phone. Tags pin only after each action.

surface_finish.observed: The leather glove, rugged phone, khaki sleeve and wrist watch with its hatched orange window read as finished authored art with shading and edges. The weakest finish is the undersized station in s5.

continuity.observed: The same tower and camera carry from 0 s to the closing. The card that leaves the head lands on the phone and the watch sits on the same wrist. At 25.025 s the windmill, plume with flag box, truck with alert, station, tower and limit tag all carry into the cut-in. Every frame carries the Illustration disclosure.

closing_payoff.observed: The top band shows the Wildfire plan folder, Filed August 24th, an open State approval slot and an outlined Expected January 2027 tag. Below, the tower still sweeps, the truck carries the landed alert and a short dashed line stops before the station badge.

first_frame.observed: Frame one is the whole tower with its beam already turning over the plains, so the subject and its watching action are visible immediately.

visual_progression.observed: Tower sweep, head close, slot card, beam to plume with flag lock, card down the tower, gloved phone, watch window, wide limit with tag, cut-in open line, wall calendar, tailgate record, desk and composite: each shot adds a new state.

shot_variety.observed: Wide tower, close head, medium cards, medium from the tower foot, detail on the gloved phone, close and detail on the watch, a wide and a cut-in in s5, a wall truck and close, and a split closing composite.

performed_turn.observed: A dashed line runs low from the truck's landed alert to the station badge, stops short with an open ring, and Can share pins beside the badge. It is small because the station is undersized.

pace.observed: A new visible change arrives at least every 4 s and no shot runs past 5 s. The weakest stretch is the 28.5 to 31.5 s wall truck where the calendar strip is small.

closing_answer.observed: The alert is landed with the crew, the line to responders stays open and the plan waits on state approval in one frame, with no invented outcome.

finished_art.observed: The tower lattice, the smoke and flag box on open ground, the alert card, glove, phone and watch read as finished authored art. The s5 station scale is the weakest finish.

clauses.observed: The tower's camera turns and its beam sweeps the land, then the head comes round to face the viewer and West Texas settles on the rail.
Tower slots light one by one to 16 installed on a card of 56.
The planned slots brighten and 56 planned by February 2027 pins, the top rows are cropped under the disclosure.
From the tower foot the beam crosses to smoke on open ground and the flag box locks on it, clear of the pumpjack.
The ALERT card leaves the head, runs down the tower and lands as the bubble on the gloved phone.
The watch's hatched ten-minute window opens and Estimated within ten minutes pins at its end.
Wide, the beam holds on the plume with its flag box beside the windmill and Doesn't prevent fires pins to the tower leg.
In the cut-in a dashed line runs from the alert on the truck toward the station badge, stops short, and Can share pins.
The shelter-wall calendar runs from Launch to Now with no red mark and Per AEP's wildfire lead pins at Now, the strip is small in the first shot.
A blank Response record slides onto the tailgate and its how much sooner field pulses and stays empty, the label is clipped.
The plan folder slides onto the desk with State approval open and Expected January 2027, then the composite holds it above the tower, the landed alert and the open line.
